engineering-quote-toolkit.objective: Validate the full Leverage business loop with the first live Gumroad product.
blockers: Authoritative Gumroad traffic metrics are not connected.
External distribution requires an approved execution path.
manual_owner_steps: Approve or perform external distribution where platform policy requires a human action.
Provide authoritative Gumroad analytics evidence until a compliant integration is available.
engineering-quote-toolkit.success_condition: At least one buyer plus authoritative traffic, conversion, delivery and revenue evidence.

levels.L3: Worker executes bounded actions with monitoring and rollback
levels.L4: Mostly autonomous operation; consequential actions remain approval-gated
